alt: A printed chart of a man’s face in profile, every part of it covered in hand-lettered words for faculties and traits, such as Hope, Memory, Caution, Dignity and Authority, titled “A Chart of the Face.”
bibliography: Sivartha, Alesha. The Book of Life; or, The Spiritual, Social, and Physical Constitution of Man. Sivartha Publishing, 1898.
